items.description: Map all repository modules and data flow end-to-end
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/analysis/repo_module_map.md documenting .archivara/concept_evolve.py, .archivara/semantic_scholar.py, .opencode/tools/*.ts, .opencode/agents/*.md, and directory-level outputs, with explicit input/output contracts and cross-module call graph.

items.description: Formalize the univalent Bloch constant objective and success thresholds
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/analysis/problem_statement.md with formal definition of Bu, current best lower bound 0.5708858, trivial upper bound 1, relation B <= Bl <= L <= Bu, and quantitative project success target (non-trivial tighter bound with proof obligations).

items.description: Run comprehensive web literature search for papers, code, and state-of-the-art methods
items.acceptance_criteria: Produce results/literature/search_log.json containing at least 5 distinct web-search query families, at least 20 total candidate sources (papers/preprints/code repositories), and per-source metadata: url, year, relevance score, and tentative category.

items.description: Create and maintain root-level sources.bib with complete BibTeX coverage
items.acceptance_criteria: Add sources.bib in repo root with at least 10 relevant BibTeX entries including Skinner 2009, Yanagihara 1995, and Bhowmik-Sen 2023, plus at least 7 additional directly relevant works; every entry must include year and either DOI or URL.

items.description: Delegate literature exploration and synthesis to subagents
items.acceptance_criteria: Run at least one exploration subagent pass (explore or literature-graph-miner) and one synthesis pass (general or writer), then publish results/literature/subagent_synthesis.md with top 5 transferable techniques, top 3 evidence-backed gaps, and citation keys mapped to sources.bib.

items.description: Define baseline metrics and reproducibility protocol
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/baseline/metric_spec.md defining primary metrics (best proven LB, best constructive UB, UB-LB gap), secondary metrics (runtime, certificate verification status), and fixed baseline points LB=0.5708858 and UB=1 with citation keys.

items.description: Assemble baseline bound registry tied to literature evidence
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/baseline/bound_registry.json with at least 5 historical bounds for related constants and Bu, each containing value, inequality direction, proof status, source key from sources.bib, and verification note.

items.description: Bootstrap concept-tree workspace for modular research execution
items.acceptance_criteria: Generate results/concept_evolve/tree/index.json, adjacency.json, and walk_paths.json with at least 14 concept nodes and non-empty edges, and verify each node has a corresponding concept folder with concept.json and literature.json.

items.description: Implement baseline sanity-check suite for canonical univalent families
items.acceptance_criteria: Publish results/baseline/sanity_checks.md covering at least 3 canonical families (identity, Koebe-type, slit-map-type), showing normalization checks, computed/estimated Bf proxy behavior, and consistency with known inequality chain.

items.description: Delegate baseline risk discovery and synthesis prioritization
items.acceptance_criteria: Run one exploration subagent on code + concept tree and one synthesis subagent on execution priorities; save results/baseline/subagent_baseline_plan.md with at least 6 ranked tasks, expected bound impact, and dependency mapping to phase-1 artifacts.

items.description: Develop at least three distinct lower-bound research strategies
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/research/lb_strategies.md with at least 3 non-overlapping LB strategy blueprints, each specifying mathematical formalization, required lemmas, expected improvement magnitude, and direct comparison to methods cited in sources.bib.

items.description: Develop constructive upper-bound candidate families
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/research/ub_constructions.md with at least 3 parameterized univalent-function families aimed at reducing UB below 1, including parameter domains, univalence checks, and optimization objective definitions.

items.description: Force concept-tree bridge exploration for novelty generation
items.acceptance_criteria: Traverse at least 12 concept folders under results/concept_evolve/tree/ and produce results/research/tree_bridge_report.md with at least 8 bridge chains, each linked to one concrete experiment seed and one supporting citation from sources.bib.

items.description: Build dependency graph for theorem and experiment execution
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/research/dependency_graph.json with at least 20 nodes and 25 edges spanning lemmas, algorithms, certificates, and experiments; every novel strategy must map to prerequisites and validation artifacts.

items.description: Delegate novelty stress test to exploration and synthesis subagents
items.acceptance_criteria: Complete one exploration pass to detect overlap with prior work and one synthesis pass to revise plan; publish results/research/subagent_novelty_review.md with at least 5 keep/modify/drop decisions and justification anchored to cited literature.

items.description: Execute pilot experiments across all core strategies
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/experiments/pilot_runs.json with at least 6 pilot runs covering all phase-3 strategies, each recording config, random seed (if applicable), runtime, and whether the run improved LB or UB candidate values.

items.description: Produce certified bound artifacts and verification logs
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/experiments/certified_bounds.json capturing current best LB and UB with certificate references and independent verification status; at least one bound claim must include rigorous numerical error control (e.g., interval validation).

items.description: Compare experimental outcomes against prior work from literature review
items.acceptance_criteria: Publish results/experiments/sota_comparison.md containing a table comparing new results with Skinner 2009, Yanagihara 1995, Bhowmik-Sen 2023 summary values, and at least 5 additional sources from sources.bib, including numeric deltas and citation keys.

items.description: Run concept-tree path ablation and robustness evaluation
items.acceptance_criteria: Use results/concept_evolve/tree/walk_paths.json to evaluate at least 10 distinct concept paths and publish results/experiments/tree_ablation.md showing which paths contributed measurable gains, which failed, and why.

items.description: Delegate experiment triage and synthesis for next iteration
items.acceptance_criteria: Run one exploration subagent to audit anomalies/outliers and one synthesis subagent to produce results/experiments/subagent_triage.md with at least 4 corrective actions, expected effect sizes, and required dependencies.

items.description: Quantify full error budget for reported bounds
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/analysis/error_budget.md decomposing numerical, truncation, and proof-gap uncertainties with explicit upper bounds, and include sensitivity checks for top 3 most influential assumptions.

items.description: Write final bound claim with rigor level and assumptions
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/analysis/final_bound_claim.md stating best proven LB/UB, whether non-trivial tightening over LB 0.5708858 or UB 1 was achieved, and a clear assumptions section linking to certificate artifacts.

items.description: Extract reusable concept-tree playbook from completed research
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/analysis/concept_tree_playbook.md referencing at least 10 folders inside results/concept_evolve/tree/ and summarizing reusable heuristics, dead-end patterns, and high-yield bridge types.

items.description: Finalize reproducibility and citation integrity package
items.acceptance_criteria: Ensure sources.bib is up to date and create results/analysis/reproducibility_checklist.md verifying every reported number maps to a reproducible artifact and every major claim cites supporting prior work.

items.description: Delegate final peer-style review (exploration plus synthesis)
items.acceptance_criteria: Run one exploration/reviewer pass and one synthesis/writer pass, then publish results/analysis/subagent_final_review.md with at least 8 review comments, disposition status for each, and any required rubric updates.
